title: SAP BTP Practice Leader
summary: I lead the SAP BTP practice and a 16-person team on cloud and on-premise architectures, from technical consulting to full-stack development.
details: Roles: Practice Leader (SME), SAP BTP Architect, Senior SAP Full Stack Technical Consultant, Team Leader.
I design SAP BTP architectures for enterprise customers and follow them into production.
I coordinate a team of 16 consultants and developers: growth, code review, technical decisions.
I build accessible web applications following the WCAG and ARIA guidelines.
